safe_answer_patterns: Annual approved operating budget totals by fiscal year.
FY2018-FY2026 comparisons by service, department, program, fund, fund type, or Labor/Non-Labor description.
FY2026 service, department, program, fund, and Labor/Non-Labor rankings.
Department drill-downs into programs, funds, fund types, and Labor/Non-Labor rows.
Inspection of negative, zero, blank, and unusual approved_amount rows.
Chart-ready tables for Seattle operating budget trends and department growth using approved_amount.
not_supported_by_this_source: Actual spending, payments, invoices, checkbook transactions, or procurement activity.
Realtime city operations, service delivery, maps, incidents, or performance data.
Staffing, headcount, FTE, vacancy, or personnel roster claims.
Capital budget, transportation capital program, or capital project analysis.
Revenue analysis beyond operating-budget fund/accounting context.
Washington state, King County, school district, or other non-Seattle budget analysis.
Policy conclusions that are not directly supported by approved operating budget rows.
caveats: Annual/static operating budget publication, not realtime data.
Negative rows may be accounting offsets, recoveries, transfers, or internal cost allocation.
Zero and blank amount rows exist and should be handled intentionally.
Utility and enterprise fund budgets can dominate totals and are not the same as discretionary priorities.
